story:
NEPA Classic Construction offers over 30 years of experience in general construction — interior and exterior — landscaping, hardscaping, and much more. We take pride in every project, treating your home as if it were our own.

Serving Scranton, Pittston, Wilkes-Barre, and surrounding communities across Northeastern Pennsylvania, we deliver quality craftsmanship at fair prices. Every project begins with a free estimate — no pressure, no surprises.

Over three decades and more than 500 completed projects, we have built a business on a simple idea: be the contractor who shows up, sends the estimate, and finishes the job. We are a fully licensed and insured Pennsylvania contractor, we pull our own permits through the Luzerne and Lackawanna County offices, and we run interior, exterior, hardscaping and landscaping crews out of one office so a homeowner only ever has one number to call.
